claim: D2 cation swaps cannot be detected (3–14% over four searches)
why_it_looked_true: Four groups of structural quantities all failed and two physical explanations seemed plausible
what_exposed_it: Madelung energy of every damaged cell was exactly zero because the damage construction was flawed
diagnostic_class: verify that each damage procedure creates a physically unfavourable structure

claim: Law thresholds were fitted only on the discovery split
why_it_looked_true: The split file existed and was cited in the written protocol
what_exposed_it: After the analysis set grew, 3,215 rows without split labels entered one fit
diagnostic_class: enforce the split in code, not only in text

claim: The satisfaction–damage-detection trade-off is a physical limit
why_it_looked_true: The pattern recurred across six targets, four input groups and three analysis levels
what_exposed_it: The search used its full allowed loss of experimental-crystal satisfaction on the first law
diagnostic_class: limit the allowed satisfaction loss at each search step

claim: No unrestricted model can exceed 87% damage detection at 99% experimental-structure satisfaction
why_it_looked_true: A boosted tree gave this result on separate parent structures
what_exposed_it: When each damage type was omitted during fitting, damage detection fell by 0.45–0.87
diagnostic_class: test on a damage type omitted during fitting

claim: Symmetry is the best single law (99.17% satisfaction, 39.5% damage detection)
why_it_looked_true: Both numbers exceeded those of the core law
what_exposed_it: Damage detection was 0.98 for random displacement and 0.00 for expansion: a pattern of the damage procedure rather than chemistry
diagnostic_class: report damage detection separately for each damage type

claim: Charge-topology quantities add nothing because removing them changes no result
why_it_looked_true: The repeated analysis matched to the last digit
what_exposed_it: The removal switch deleted only unconditional laws and left the conditional versions in place
diagnostic_class: verify that the intended quantities were actually removed

claim: Materials Project labels are noisier because the database is heterogeneous
why_it_looked_true: Accuracy rose steadily with energy difference and adding label noise reproduced the trend
what_exposed_it: Three databases computed with consistent settings all scored below Materials Project in matched energy ranges

claim: Structural criteria are an energy proxy (0.6603 = 0.6603, exact)
why_it_looked_true: The two values agreed to four decimal places
what_exposed_it: On the subset ranked correctly by energy the two quantities are equal by definition
diagnostic_class: check whether an apparent agreement follows from the definition

claim: Density predicts synthesis history better than formation energy
what_exposed_it: SiO2 supplied 43.6% of all pairs. Giving each composition equal weight reversed the result to 0.6347 versus 0.7451
diagnostic_class: report how many pairs each composition contributes

claim: Pauling's rules perform worse than chance (0.14–0.36)
why_it_looked_true: The values were far below chance and seemed to have a symmetry-based explanation
what_exposed_it: Ties made up 77.7% of pairs and were counted as errors. Experimentally recorded entries were actually more symmetric (space group 87 versus 62)

claim: An upper contact bound adds no value because the law must be one-sided
why_it_looked_true: At 99% satisfaction the best range is [0.73, 3.04], so the upper bound detects no additional damage and damage detection (0.2823) is below the one-sided law (0.2881)
what_exposed_it: At equal satisfaction below 95%, the best upper bound changes sharply from about 3.0 to 1.08 and improves damage detection by up to 0.16
diagnostic_class: compare the two forms at the same satisfaction rather than only at 99%
